title: The 9 best AI agents for customer service in 2026, compared
summary: Compare 9 AI agents for customer service, with honest best-for picks, measured automation benchmarks from 100+ merchants, and a buying guide for your pilot.
body_markdown:
### What is Yuma AI?


Yuma is an AI-first customer service platform for ecommerce that resolves tickets autonomously across email, chat, and social channels, plus phone through Yuma Voice. It's built for Shopify brands and runs on top of the helpdesk you already use, such as Gorgias or Zendesk. In Yuma 2.0, one written Handbook runs every channel, and nothing reaches a customer until a person publishes it.


### What is an AI agent for customer service?


An AI agent for customer service is software that resolves support tickets from start to finish by taking real actions in your systems, such as issuing refunds, canceling orders, or updating a shipping address. It works inside your existing helpdesk and commerce stack, follows the rules you set, and hands the ticket to a person when a request falls outside its scope.


### How much does Yuma AI cost?


Yuma uses outcome-based pricing, so brands pay for tickets Yuma fully resolves, with no charge for conversations or escalations. Yuma publishes its[pricing tiers](https://yuma.ai/pricing) and offers an ROI calculator on its website. Setup by Yuma's account team is included at no extra cost, and a free 30-day trial lets you test on live tickets first.


### How accurate is AI in customer service?


Accuracy depends as much on architecture as on the underlying model. Systems that load an entire knowledge base into one prompt are more likely to guess when unsure, while specialized architectures isolate context and validate every draft before it sends. Expect high accuracy on structured, money-touching tasks and an immediate handoff on everything else, since no AI is error-free. For example,[Glossier](https://yuma.ai/case-studies/a-glossier-touch-elevating-customer-experience-with-yuma-ai) reached 91% accuracy on shipping-status tickets from launch with Yuma, parsing tracking links across carriers to resolve issues without human intervention. Read our full guide on[how accurate AI is in customer support](https://yuma.ai/blogs/how-accurate-is-ai-in-customer-support) .


### How do you prevent AI hallucinations in customer service?


There are 3 design choices that can reduce hallucinations: load only the facts the current task needs, run a quality check on every draft before it sends, and hand the ticket to a person instead of guessing when the rules run out. Every Yuma playbook carries its own tests, which rerun whenever a policy changes, and Yuma hands the conversation to a person when the Handbook is silent. The technical detail is in[AI hallucinations in customer service](https://yuma.ai/blogs/ai-hallucinations-in-customer-service-why-quality-control-architecture-matters) .


### What is a good automation rate for customer support tickets?


In Yuma's benchmark of 100+ Shopify merchants, the typical merchant reaches 71% automation of eligible tickets on its best day, and the best brand sustains 87% across a full quarter. Your own rate depends on which ticket types the AI is allowed to own, since informational tickets automate easily and money-touching ones depend on the actions you grant. These merchants run on Yuma, so treat the figures as a production reference rather than an industry average.


### What is the difference between an AI agent and a chatbot?


A chatbot answers questions from a script or a knowledge base. An AI agent takes the actions that close the ticket, such as a refund, a cancellation, or an address change.


### Are customers satisfied with AI-driven support compared with older systems?


In Yuma's benchmark of 100+ merchants, CSAT holds at a 4.5 out of 5 median, and the correlation between automation level and satisfaction is negligible (Pearson r = -0.18). Higher automation didn't pull scores down across those merchants. They're Yuma customers, so ask any vendor for the same cut of its own data.


### Can AI agents handle product-specific questions like sizing, fit, or compatibility?


Yes, when the agent is connected to your product catalog and order data. Sizing and fit, shade matching, and electronics compatibility are common examples. Yuma can also read photos customers send, which helps with shade matching and troubleshooting.


### Which customer support platforms have built-in AI agents?


Gorgias, Zendesk, Fin (formerly Intercom), and Tidio each offer an AI agent inside their own platform: Gorgias AI, Zendesk AI, Fin, and Lyro. Yuma and Siena sit on top of a helpdesk you already run, while Ada and Sierra connect to your existing helpdesk or contact center. Fin can also run on top of helpdesks like Zendesk or Salesforce, and Forethought, now sold by Zendesk, still runs on other helpdesks too.


### Can AI agents handle refunds and returns?


Yes. An agent connected to your commerce platform and returns tools, such as Shopify and Loop Returns, can check eligibility against your return window, issue the refund or store credit, and generate a return label. You control the risk with hard limits, such as a maximum refund per order and a daily cap on refunds.


### Can AI agents access subscription data like Recharge?


Yes, ecommerce-focused agents can connect to subscription tools such as Recharge, Skio, and Loop Subscriptions. They can look up, pause, skip, resume, or cancel a subscription during the conversation.[Petlibro](https://yuma.ai/case-studies/how-petlibro-achieved-49-automation-and-saves-20-annually-with-yuma-ai) , which automates 79% of its tickets with Yuma, says its team no longer worries about subscription management.
